scope: Row/column page-break axes and retained XLSX bounds; broader rendering family remains open under #1748.

calc.evidence: worksheetfragment.cxx:448-453,728-736 passes true for rowBreaks, false for colBreaks; worksheethelper.cxx:673-680 selects getRow for true and getColumn for false.

gnumeric.evidence: XML hPageBreaks is_vert=false, vPageBreaks=true. print-info.c assigns h/v accordingly; print.c:1085-1095 consumes v for columns and h for rows. BIFF reader assigns horizontal=false, vertical=true; writer emits horizontal/vertical records from the same semantic axes.
gnumeric.discrepancy: Gnumeric XLSX rowBreaks passes true and colBreaks false. This inherited source inconsistency is deliberately corrected; Gnumeric XLSX roundtrip is not used as a correctness oracle.

regressions.originalFailure: Both original in-memory XLSX package inputs produced one PDF page instead of two. Untouched bounds/manual flags were lost on XLSX export.
preservation: Untouched bounds, explicit flags and container attributes
Untouched siblings when another break changes

pdfQualification.limitations: XLSX/BIFF export materializes styles outside this axis repair; their normalized break transport is qualified separately from original-package/XML PDF rendering.

odfInspection.result: No normalized PrintInformation page-break import/export exists in the ODF transport. soft-page-break is schema-recognized without projection. No ODF axis inversion or new ODF page-break support is claimed.
